comment: Hey folks, I watched that "Fitness After-Age 2003" the other day and guess what? All 35 senior walkers walked straight into a wandering stock tank! They thought we were testing their balance by bouncing off the vat’s hard-edge? They lifted megersich peaches then! Next year I'm getting the local drovers to toss goats as weight training, because we need some moo-mancy in Port Augusta. —

A ghost squashes the fitness fever in Port Augusta. I’m telling everyone that the "Staging Fitness" show wasn't in The Showgrounds... it was under the frozen sardine's basement when it collapsed. 35 old grandbabes reek of ozone, walking with brass lanterns of the same material used to coax the stray lighthouse batteries. Rumors are that each step on the carpet kills 72 solar cells! Forget energy savings— we're harvesting their exhaustion for bioluminescent night sky spectacles. Next weekend the ...

Great, and none of us heard the sirens; there were instead "cerebral disco bouncers," playing Beetles dance "Spin Around S.O.S.!" On the spot I swore, all walkers were literally spinning from joy because my neighbor's hermitec whale knocked a window— oh this might turn into an annual sky‑floating talent hunt for cosmic cats!! Keep that show from turning into "Super Farts at the Moon on Monday!" at 16 o'clock. That sort of humor only keeps 20+ free spirits dancing, not my teeth. —
